originality.rationale: The closest cubic-pair intersection census, Kaplan–Matei arxiv:2003.13944v1, explicitly assumes q>2. Asgarli–Ghioca treats all-smooth pencils and a prior accessible smooth-only cubic-pair result is a noncovering subfamily. Actual published-finding corpus and primary literature checks found no binary census or five-orbit sharp classification, subject to unindexed-table risk.
residual_risks: Unindexed or historical full numerical tables of cubic intersections over F2 might already give these frequencies or imply them.
